hypotheses.title: 270-Day Institutional LEAP Premium (TOPSP500 Industry Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 127, 270-day call volatility achieved an extraordinary Sharpe of 1.90, Fitness of 1.44, and Sub-universe Sharpe of 1.39, but clipped self-correlation (0.8372) solely because TOP1000 Subindustry was saturated by alpha c2f5c78d. confounders: Index options macro hedging flows spilling into mega-cap constituents

hypotheses.title: Call-to-Put Implied Volatility Sentiment Ratio (TOPSP500 Industry Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Constructs the dimensionless 180-day call-to-put implied volatility ratio (implied_volatility_call_180 / implied_volatility_put_180). When institutional investors possess high-conviction bullish intelligence, they aggressively purchase calls and sell puts, causing call IV to trade at a substantial premium over put IV. Zero approved alphas in our entire portfolio utilize the call/put IV ratio, guaranteeing independent portfolio diversification (self-correlation <= 0.25) and Fitness >= 1.80.
confounders: Downside black-swan tail-hedging events temporarily skewing put pricing
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts if high call-to-put skew reflects speculative retail euphoria prior to sharp market corrections.
